name: neon-pink-bathroom-selfie
image_purpose: bathroom mirror, cap, phone, and color styling reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in bold pink casual styling.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dirty-blonde/light-brown waves, blue-green eyes, rose-pattern camouflage cap, opaque white waffle-knit short-sleeve top with blue trim, high-waisted hot-pink leggings, chunky gold chain, and orange phone case.
prompt.composition_elements: Profile/three-quarter mirror selfie with phone raised, white paneled door, generic framed coral artwork, sink, mirror water spots and toothpaste smudges, no exaggerated hip emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright artificial overhead bathroom light with warm casual mood and realistic mirror imperfections.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, accurate reflection, natural skin texture, realistic fabric detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long dirty-blonde waves takes a three-quarter bathroom mirror selfie wearing a rose-pattern camouflage cap, opaque white waffle-knit top with blue trim, and high-waisted hot-pink leggings. Include orange phone case, white door, generic coral artwork, sink, mirror water spots, and bright overhead light. Keep the pose casual and non-sexualized.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop top, exposed midriff, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized hip emphasis, nudity, distorted reflection, extra fingers, private text, watermark, public figure likeness.
